ownership.fundingNotes: Spanish edition of HuffPost, operated under PRISA license. Revenue from digital advertising. Known for progressive editorial line and viral content model.

justification.es: Identificacion de fuentes aceptable en noticias propias. Alto volumen de contenido de agencia y blogs de colaboradores.
justification.en: Acceptable source identification in own news. High volume of wire and contributor blog content.

justification.es: Diversidad limitada. Predominan voces progresistas en opinion y analisis.
justification.en: Limited diversity. Progressive voices predominate in opinion and analysis.

justification.es: Enlaces presentes pero no sistematicos. Predominan enlaces internos.
justification.en: Links present but not systematic. Internal links predominate.

justification.es: Documentacion adjunta infrecuente. El formato viral no favorece la documentacion.
justification.en: Infrequent attached documentation. Viral format does not favor documentation.

justification.es: Sin seccion de datos. Infografias basicas ocasionales.
justification.en: No data section. Occasional basic infographics.

justification.es: Politica de correcciones poco visible.
justification.en: Low-visibility corrections policy.

justification.es: Ratio de errores moderada. El alto volumen de publicacion genera errores puntuales.
justification.en: Moderate error ratio. High publication volume generates occasional errors.

justification.es: Rectificacion reactiva.
justification.en: Reactive rectification.

justification.es: Alta tendencia al clickbait. Los titulares buscan viralidad sobre precision.
justification.en: High clickbait tendency. Headlines seek virality over accuracy.

justification.es: Marcas temporales presentes.
justification.en: Timestamps present.

justification.es: Material multimedia correcto. Uso de contenido viral y redes sociales.
justification.en: Correct multimedia material. Use of viral and social media content.

justification.es: Seleccion de expertos limitada. Los blogs de colaboradores no siempre son expertos verificados.
justification.en: Limited expert selection. Contributor blogs are not always verified experts.

justification.es: Articulos de redaccion firmados. Alto volumen de contenido de blogs con autoria variable.
justification.en: Signed newsroom articles. High volume of blog content with variable authorship.
justification.ca: Articles signats. Alt volum de blogs.
justification.eu: Sinatutako artikuluak. Blog eduki bolumen altua.
justification.gl: Artigos asinados. Alto volume de blogs.

justification.es: Sin Defensor del Lector. Rendicion de cuentas limitada.
justification.en: No Reader's Ombudsman. Limited accountability.

justification.es: Contenido patrocinado integrado con el editorial. La dependencia publicitaria es total.
justification.en: Sponsored content integrated with editorial. Advertising dependence is total.

justification.es: Sin politica publica sobre uso de IA.
justification.en: No public policy on AI usage.

justification.es: Carga adjetival moderada-alta en contenido politico. Tono activista en temas sociales.
justification.en: Moderate-high adjectival load in political content. Activist tone in social topics.

justification.es: Verbos con asimetria progresista moderada.
justification.en: Verbs with moderate progressive asymmetry.

justification.es: Los blogs de opinion estan separados pero la linea editorial progresista permea todo el contenido.
justification.en: Opinion blogs are separated but progressive editorial line permeates all content.
justification.eu: Iritzi-blogak bereizita baina lerro editorial progresistak eduki guztia zehazkatzen du.

justification.es: Sesgo progresista marcado en seleccion de temas. Alta cobertura de temas de genero, derechos LGTBI y critica a la derecha.
justification.en: Marked progressive bias in topic selection. High coverage of gender, LGBTI rights and right-wing criticism.

justification.es: Asimetria editorial notable. Escrutinio asimetrico.
justification.en: Notable editorial asymmetry. Asymmetric scrutiny.

justification.es: Encuadre progresista en toda la cobertura politica y social.
justification.en: Progressive framing in all political and social coverage.
justification.eu: Markaketa progresista estaldura politiko eta sozial guztian.

justification.es: Tratamiento de encuestas con sesgo progresista.
justification.en: Progressive poll treatment bias.

justification.es: Seleccion visual con sesgo moderado. Material viral frecuente.
justification.en: Visual selection with moderate bias. Frequent viral material.

justification.es: Estructura PRISA/BuzzFeed conocida publicamente.
justification.en: PRISA/BuzzFeed structure publicly known.

justification.es: Alta dependencia publicitaria. Proporcion institucional no desglosada.
justification.en: High advertising dependence. Institutional proportion not broken down.

justification.es: La relacion con PRISA y la dependencia publicitaria total generan conflictos de interes potenciales no declarados.
justification.en: PRISA relationship and total advertising dependence generate potential undeclared conflicts of interest.
justification.ca: La relacio amb PRISA i la dependencia publicitaria.
justification.gl: A relacion con PRISA e a dependencia publicitaria.
